QuestInfo.name: A Village on Guard
QuestInfo.0: You come to a newly-discovered area, #m310000000#, but no one will talk to you. All the residents seem to go about their business without saying a word... you wonder what's going on... Ask Headmaster #b#p2152000##k, who looks the most gentlemanly out of everyone.
QuestInfo.1:
The residents of this town aren't hard of hearing or unable to speak, and they certainly don't value silence. Apparently, they just don't like talking to you, but you don't know why... There might be #ba resident who is willing to answer your question#k. See if you can find someone.

#y23901# #b(#u23901#)#k
#y23902# #b(#u23902#)#k
QuestInfo.2: Everyone in this town seems to have a grudge against the #p1101000# Knights. You wonder why...

0.0: What business brings you here? I'd welcome you, but the truth is, you won't find many friendly faces here... \r\n#L0##bWhy don't the people in this town say anything?#l\n#k
0.1: Because of you... \r\n#L0##bMe? But I've never even been here before...#l\n#k
0.2: It seems you really don't know what's going on. Still, all I can tell you is this: Not a single adult in this town will talk to you. Do you understand?

yes.0: #b(Huh? What's going on? If no one will talk to you, how will you ever get any information?)#k
yes.1: #b(But there's got to be SOMEONE in this town who'll talk to you. Look around and maybe you'll find someone.)#k

1.0: I can tell you've discovered something... \r\n#L0##bThe people here hate all #p1101000# Knights. But why? We fight against the Black Mage! We don't hurt people... Why are they saying we're as bad as the Black Wings?#l\n#k

quest.0: Rules are rules. I can't tell you anything. But maybe one of the #bchildren#k will...
